text:
You need a creative, AI-driven web developer who can help turn a travel resource website into a visually engaging, content-rich, SEO-friendly platform with seamless navigation and a strong user experience.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, which makes me well suited to help shape a polished travel platform that feels fast, intuitive, and scalable.

For a travel website like this, I’d focus on building a responsive front end that makes it easy for visitors to explore destinations, discover content, and move through the site without friction. Using React and Next.js, I can create a structured, performance-focused experience that supports both strong usability and SEO goals. On the backend, Node.js and PostgreSQL can support clean data handling and flexible content workflows, while REST APIs can connect the site’s key features and data sources.

I also understand the importance of balancing creativity with clarity. A travel resource site needs more than attractive visuals; it needs a layout and information structure that helps users find what they want quickly while still feeling inspiring. With Tailwind CSS, I can help implement a modern, consistent design system that keeps the interface clean and adaptable across devices.

If your team is exploring AI-assisted content or optimization workflows, I’d be glad to collaborate on ways to incorporate them thoughtfully into the product without sacrificing quality or consistency. I’m comfortable working in a collaborative environment and aligning development decisions with design, content, and engagement goals.

I’d welcome the opportunity to help build a travel website that is not only attractive and easy to use, but also designed to support long-term growth, performance, and a strong visitor experience.
